Prepares, on a deliberate click, the chosen month's leases the Working batch shows under its open group, tag and Search this month's leases. Its name counts them, such as Prepare 4 of 9 December 2026 leases when a filter narrows the list, and the line beside it says how many need a comparison, how many already have one and the monthly allowance left. At the allowance, the rest read Not run: the monthly allowance is reached.
Opens the one status, note and History control in Guided and Full.
Shows all lease sections while retaining the same lease context.

Opens the applicable staff work records. Choosing an event opens its form without recording work.
Shows the owner message step on the Now card. When covered by an agreement, the primary is Continue to Offer the tenant; existing message tools remain available.
The Now card's primary action when the owner message is ready. It opens Review and send with the exact message, the recipients and the sender; nothing is sent until Send this message.
The stored comparison, Rent to recommend, Reason to include and the message preview.
Continues a covered owner step at Offer the tenant in the same view. Replaces the misleading Send the owner message primary on that covered card; all message tools remain available.

The existing staff-recorded animal follow-up, with the same saved activity and source-update confirmations. Its name carries no registration requirement. The related readiness label formerly Pet deposit + registration is Animal charges and agreement; its predicates and severity are preserved.
Shows the exact observed owner reply as plain text with its time and staff mailbox, with explicit loading, partial and retry states; a reply makes no decision for staff.
Deliberately rebuilds a stale authored message from current inputs; the existing authored wording is recoverable with Undo the last refinement.
Restores the previous authored wording after a deliberate return to standard wording or accepted refinement.

Retries a failed Housing assistance save with the entered complete value through the same working-record save. Saving is visible and the entry remains available after a failure. The focused retry stays visible while saved content changes around it.

The one recovery beside the compact preview checks the same uncertain Gmail draft attempt, with visible progress. A confirmed recovery refreshes the recorded draft and its message revision. Full view keeps its existing Unsent Gmail draft control; a new attempt waits on exact recovery.

control: Check tenant email addresses in RentVine
expectation: A missing tenant recipient focuses its reasons and the existing lease source-record handoff. Only verified source destinations are used; a provider correction needs its own outside work and refresh.

control: Ask an Approver to publish the tenant template
expectation: A missing tenant message template opens and focuses its current publication status for the existing Approver handoff. Publication stays with the Approver's existing controls.

Retries the retained Rent to recommend entry through its existing working-record save. Saved appears only after acknowledgment of that exact entry. Review and delivery preparation wait on their own confirmed financial fields; Copy stays available with the displayed bytes and an unconfirmed-figures notice.

Reads the same linked owner reply again and keeps staff entries. The retry keeps focus during loading, then focuses the reply heading when it is still in use. An operator who moved to a decision keeps that focus.
Moves focus to the tenant message's existing Marked values links. A missing shared form points to its exact Connections entry. Preparing a review waits for the marked value.
Returns from another step to the current next step in the same tab and follows that step's progress. Choosing a step saves nothing.
The Now card's primary action when the tenant offer is ready. It opens Review and send with the exact offer, the recipients and the sender; nothing is sent until Send this message.

Leads Check the numbers with the verified current base rent and its source. A separate charge such as pet rent is named apart from the base, and a missing or contradicted base reads Needs verification.
Shown when the base is missing, contradicted or not confirmed by billing. It moves to Working current rent in Correct other lease facts; nothing changes RentVine or the Sheet.

In Full view, Owner approval shows the current base rent, the market range and Rent to recommend read only. This link opens the one Rent to recommend editor in Market rent comparison; a person without Editor access sees View rent to recommend. In Guided view the Now card's Edit opens the same editor in place.

The monthly base rent exactly as the owner approved it, entered by staff. Nothing fills it by itself; when this cycle has a rent to recommend, Same as recommended, with that amount in parentheses, fills it on your choice. A note under the coverage choice says what the answer means at Documents, and before the dates are saved Enter the renewal dates in Working renewal terms opens them.
Shows the recommended base rent, the amount approved, what the answer covers and the evidence before anything saves.

control: Use the day after the current lease ends
expectation: Ask the owner's Working renewal terms: save the day after the verified current lease end as the Working effective date, with that basis; the end date stays a manual entry.
Check the numbers' named Work group: Lease term, Rent and charges, Correct a lease fact and the RentVine and Sheet update reviews. It starts closed unless it holds the current work.
Check the numbers' read-only Verification: the lease term facts, rent and charge evidence, Update status by destination and Data check with its source links.
Compare market rent's named Work group: Market evidence with the search radius, your own sourced figures and the one deliberate lookup.
Compare market rent's read-only Verification: the stored comparison with its comparable rows and when it was recorded.

Ask the owner's named record group, renamed from the combined options and record group: Compose owner message in Communications, Copy the message, the unsent Gmail draft, Marked values, Work recorded by staff and Owner response. On the Now card, Message and Other ways to send come before it.

formerly.control: Owner message options and outreach record

expectation: Ask the owner's read-only Verification: Prior owner decision and provider evidence and the outreach facts.

Offer the tenant's named record group, renamed from the combined options and record group: Compose tenant message in Communications, Copy the message, the unsent Gmail draft, the charge and response options, Work recorded by staff, Tenant response and Waiting and follow-up. On the Now card, Message and Other ways to send come before it.

formerly.control: Tenant offer options and record of contact

expectation: Offer the tenant's read-only Verification: Earlier tenant offer evidence, kept as evidence while the current message preparation governs.
Documents and signatures' named Work group: Renewal resource links and the policy content. The packet work above it stays open.
Documents and signatures' read-only Verification: Document readiness evidence.

Finish up's named Work group: the other follow-ups. The follow-up shown above it is the first open one when you arrive and stays there while you work it, with your typed entries; the next one moves up at your next arrival. Source updates stays above the group.
Finish up's read-only Verification: Notice timing.
Complete's read-only Verification: Completion checks. Complete has no Work group.

Leads Documents and signatures with one thing: the first packet input, a form held on a named difference, the Source pending handoff with the missing evidence and responsible role, or the signing wait.
Opens Packet inputs at the named fact for an Editor; it saves nothing. Other people read An Editor enters it in Packet inputs.
Ask the owner's one Working renewal terms editor, its own named reveal: the verified current lease end, Working effective date and Working term end date.
Offer the tenant's charge review: each charge line with its source, include or leave out with a reason, corrections with their source, the transitions and exact totals.

control: Add a charge for this lease only
expectation: An optional charge for this lease only, added with its case source; it joins Review offer charges and saves with the tenant message.

control: Which offer does this answer respond to?
expectation: Shown after Accepted, Counter / change requested or Declined / not renewing: each offer the tenant received, a confirmed send or a Gmail draft verified as sent, and Not one exact offer. It starts on Choose the offer; choosing saves nothing.

control: Where you verified it was sent
expectation: Shown when the chosen offer is a Gmail draft: where staff checked it went out, such as the Gmail Sent folder entry and its date, saved with the answer.
Records the tenant's answer again with the exact offer it answers. Answers the offer names it, and the line above says whether the answer covers the current offer or needs verification.

control: The owner approved these exact offer charges
expectation: Shown with Approved when the reviewed tenant offer lists charges, naming them. Checked with Base rent and the renewal dates, the saved approval covers that exact offer, charges included.

Shown on Check the numbers for a lease whose end date in the renewal window is not a month end: the RentVine end date, Include in this renewal month or Keep on hold with a required Reason, Save, the recorded decision with who and when, and Earlier decisions. A decision applies to that exact end date.
Saved with a Reason: the off-cycle lease belongs to this renewal month, so its preparation and sending continue and the off-cycle line leaves the stage. Editors and above.
Saved with a Reason: the lease's preparation and sending wait, and the stage line reads Off-cycle end date on hold with the reason, who set it and when. Editors and above.
The Now card's fix while an off-cycle end date needs review or is on hold, also offered in What sending needs; it opens Lease end date review at Include in this renewal month. It saves nothing.

Under the waiting line on Ask the owner or Offer the tenant, beside Last checked for a reply: checks this lease's sent messages for a reply once and reads the step again. A failed check reads Reply check failed at with the time. It records no answer and sends nothing. Editors and above.

control: Enter the renewal dates in Working renewal terms
expectation: Shown in the owner's answer before the renewal dates are saved: opens the renewal start date in Working renewal terms, with Return to the owner's answer to come back. It saves nothing.
Shown in Working renewal terms after Enter the renewal dates in Working renewal terms: returns to Amount approved in the owner's answer with the entries kept.

The fix words at the end of a Needs a check stage line, when the staff record and the lease's messages disagree about a reply: opens the Owner response or Tenant response editor that settles it. Record the owner outreach and Record the tenant offer do the same for an outreach the staff record does not show.

Shown after a Tenant response is chosen and before it is saved: Response, Answers with the offer's rent, dates and selected charges or No offer has been sent from the app yet, and what follows, such as Reminders for this offer stop. Next: send the renewal information form. Save records the response and stops this offer's reminders; Cancel keeps the earlier response.
Shown after Reminders are still scheduled. when a saved tenant response could not stop this offer's reminders: pauses them once more. It only pauses and sends nothing.

The primary action while the scheduled offer is out of date or held because the lease changed: opens one review of the offer rebuilt from the lease, carrying the earlier date and time while they are still ahead, and confirming saves and schedules or sends it once. Ask the owner reads Review the updated owner message.

Shown with the message preview while the scheduled offer is out of date or held: opens Cancel the scheduled offer?, and confirming sends nothing, keeps the communication's history and offers the step's send action again. Ask the owner reads Cancel the scheduled owner message.

Approvers and Admins, while the owner wording that asks about the term is unpublished: shows how many unsent owner messages will be held, with Publish the new owner wording and Keep the current wording. Publishing makes owner messages state the renewal term. Editors do not see it.

Leads the Now card on Ask the owner: Current base rent with its basis, Market with the comparison's source, range, comparable listings and compared date, and Rent to recommend with Edit. The To and Cc line follows it, before the primary action.
Edit beside Rent to recommend in Facts for the owner ask: opens the one Rent to recommend editor in place on the Now card; Enter saves it and focus returns to the primary action.

The message group under the primary action on Ask the owner and Offer the tenant, closed when you arrive: the current wording, What sending needs and Reason to include. It opens by itself when a wording or readiness fix leads, and leaves the step once Gmail accepts the message.

The second group under the primary action, closed when you arrive: Schedule, Create Gmail draft instead, Copy and Open in Communications. It is not shown while the message is held, and leaves the step once Gmail accepts the message.

Shown in Source updates when two or more recorded Sheet updates are pending; the number counts them. Prepares up to 10 of them, in field order, as one preview that Apply 2 Sheet updates confirms once under Review Sheet updates. A remaining count is named for the next review.

In the step's Verification once Gmail accepts the owner message: the exact sent message, read only, with when, from whom and to whom Gmail accepted it. Offer the tenant shows Sent tenant offer. It reads one stored message and sends nothing.

Shown in Working renewal terms while the end date is empty and a start is chosen: saves the end date a 12 month term gives, with the basis 12 month term chosen by staff. When the current lease runs a whole number of months other than 12, Use the current lease's length offers that end too. A start on February 29 asks for the end date instead.
